ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
RS3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)and B1-3, NeighborhoodShopping
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 8-F in the area bound by:
      a line T2feelsouth of and parallel to West 35th Street; the alley next east of and
      parallel to South Hasted Street;a line 168 feet south of and parallel to West 35th
      Street; and, South Halsted Street

to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                a
                                               Nicole Lee
                                               Aldenvoman, 11th Ward




Gommon Address:
3509-15 South Halsted Street
